scope: CPU-only reuse of the existing public Q435 conjugation cache for factor, root and series levels. Optional extra-level registration preserves rejection of unregistered levels. No new encrypted keys or key conversion at evaluation time.
unit_validation: Native N16/N512 cache arithmetic comparisons still pass. Shared dispatcher at Q165 and Q121 matches the separately prepared reference. With no extra-level registration, Q121 is rejected; registered Q121 still rejects Q122. Existing N16 schoolbook gadget oracle and legacy key constructor checks remain enabled.
payload_formula: Four PackedP(Q435, primary8, secondary16) FFT derivation caches, 22 ordinary Q435 gadget ciphertext rows and the duplicate 20/20 two-prime prepared basis cache. Sizes evaluated from the actual C++ types. Allocation bookkeeping and process RSS are separate.
lifetime_fix: The replay no longer retains a second PublicPackedAutoDeriver, its source FFT caches, ordinary gadget rows or a separate basis cache after setup. The existing public callback owns its immutable cache and survives packed-key release.
timing_limit: Setup savings and full ciphertext equality are qualified separately. Removing duplicate setup does not establish the paper functional-latency target.
